interactiveObjects.name: Ironbound Vault Door
interactiveObjects.description: A reinforced oak and banded-iron portal securing the Haven High Vault.

failureConsequence.message: A loud metallic clang echoes down the cobblestones as your pick jams in the tumblers!

transcript.speaker: Physical Interaction
transcript.text: With a satisfying click of heavy brass tumblers, the ironbound door creaks inward, granting access to the interior vault!

interactiveObjects.name: Gilded Treasury Strongbox
interactiveObjects.description: A cedar coffer bound in brass filigree, sitting upon a stone pedestal inside the vault.

trap.name: Spring-Loaded Bronze Dart
trap.description: A tensioned wire connected to a pressurized dart launcher inside the lock housing.

transcript.speaker: Physical Interaction
transcript.text: The lock springs open! Inside lies a velvet-lined cache containing 60 silver drachmae and an ancient silver chalice!

interactiveObjects.name: Massive Overgrown Granite Boulder
interactiveObjects.unpickableReason: A colossal solid granite boulder has no mechanical lock or keyhole. It cannot be lockpicked!
interactiveObjects.description: A monolithic boulder choked with ivy, completely sealing an arched fissure in the cliffside.

transcript.speaker: Feat of Power
transcript.text: Bracing your shoulders against the massive stone, you heave with all your might. With a grinding crunch, the boulder rolls aside, revealing the hidden passage to the Sunken Grotto!

interactiveObjects.name: Lord Karas' Marble Sarcophagus
interactiveObjects.description: A carved marble tomb relief depicting the warlord Karas holding a solar emblem.
